title: Pipeline Robustness Filter of Exhaustive Readout-Degenerate Tile Classes
status: CONTROLLED PIPELINE-GUARD / R4-R6 ROBUSTNESS RESULT; NOT PHYSICAL DARK-MATTER WITNESS
controlled_ruling: In this finite-tile stress model, no non-symmetry hidden pair is selection-guaranteed at single-corridor Bandwidth B=1, while 148 readout classes contain a non-symmetry pair whose R5/R6 selected corridor topology remains separated for every deterministic source-grounded score condition at B=2..4 and all 10,000 random weight stresses.
interpretation: A multi-corridor capacity threshold emerges as a controlled sandbox feature: robust hidden topology retention begins once the resolution stage can retain at least two corridors.
hard_boundary: B is a controlled corridor-count proxy for finite Bandwidth; this is not yet a source-derived physical Bandwidth calibration or theorem.
